dod_intent_evidence: USSOCOM technical experimentation, an xTech Adaptive Strike first-round award, and repeated OUSD T-REX 25-1/25-2 demonstrations at Camp Atterbury/Fort Irwin (News + Insights sections).
score_evidence: 'Sandman™ Unmanned Aerial Systems (UAS) technology offers Group 2 capabilities in a Group 1 form factor to the most forward elements of the battlefield' — detailed hardware/payload claim with zero mention of ATO/RMF/CMMC/ITAR/comms-link resilience → deployment_awareness_absence

Open roles: Robotics/Autonomy Engineer, Embedded Software Engineer - Flight Stack, two Aero Mechanical Engineers, two Electrical Engineers, two UAS GNC Engineers, Director of Product Management — all core R&D/design, zero field service, sustainment, ISSO, or compliance roles → hiring_profile_skew
'Our solutions are born from genuine defense challenges... informed by operators, and shaped by mission needs' — operators are named repeatedly as the design input → operator_absence (low)

blind_spots.blind_spot: No mention of the comms link the Sandman/Darqmatter sensing pipeline depends on once it leaves demo conditions.
blind_spots.operator_reality: A UAS marketed for 'the most forward elements of the battlefield' will hit RF-denied or degraded links in a real contested AO; without frame-decoupling or store-and-forward design (the canonical 30fps crowd-detection failure), the sensor feed just stops.
blind_spots.why_likely_missing: Company language is still calibrated to accelerator/demo audiences (T-REX, xTech) rather than a fielded acquisition program with a live adversary EW picture.
blind_spots.evidence_quote: Sandman™ Unmanned Aerial Systems (UAS) technology offers Group 2 capabilities in a Group 1 form factor to the most forward elements of the battlefield, first responder units, and search & rescue teams.

blind_spots.blind_spot: Zero ATO/RMF/CMMC/ITAR language despite an AI-powered system meant to feed government networks.
blind_spots.operator_reality: Moving from an OUSD T-REX demonstration to a program of record requires an Authority to Operate and company-level CMMC posture; if that clock hasn't started, the transition stalls regardless of how well Sandman performs in the field.
blind_spots.why_likely_missing: 1431 words of own-language never touch compliance — the team's public voice is still accelerator/press-release oriented, not acquisition-process oriented.
blind_spots.evidence_quote: American-made, AI-powered unmanned aerial systems for human-machine teaming and remote sensing technology, bringing next-gen tech to the Government.

blind_spots.blind_spot: All ten open reqs are design/build engineering roles; nothing for field integration, training, or sustainment even as the company racks up live government demos.
blind_spots.operator_reality: An E-5 handed Sandman at a forward site needs someone who trained on battery logistics, GFE integration, and field repair — none of that function is being hired for while the airframe/sensor engineering team scales.
blind_spots.why_likely_missing: Team is still in a build-and-demonstrate phase (T-REX, xTech) rather than a sustain-in-the-field phase, so hiring reflects R&D priorities only.
blind_spots.evidence_quote: Robotics/Autonomy Engineer - Computer Vision; Embedded Software Engineer - Flight Stack; UAS GNC Engineer; Aero Mechanical Engineer - UAV Design

opener_hook: Knightwerx just finished T-REX 25-2 at Camp Atterbury after OUSD's assessment at T-REX 25-1 — what's the plan for Sandman's sensor feed when the RF link degrades outside test conditions?
what_they_do: Builds a small tactical UAS (Sandman) and a wind-sensing payload (Darqmatter) aimed at forward battlefield, first-responder, and search-and-rescue use.
